question: The annual growth rate of consumer confidence index from 2000 to 2008
query: SELECT   TRUNCATE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2008 THEN consumer_confidence_index END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 - 2000  THEN consumer_confidence_index END)) FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2008;
